knownLimitations: This baseline contains source-only Studio contracts and an Asset/Drama-project UI. The backend migration and routes have not been deployed, so a 3.0.25 APK connected to production cannot create or sync Studio projects yet.

Studio production confirmations, price locks, one-time confirmation tokens, per-shot execution, and Canvas MP4 composition are intentionally not implemented. The five document editors do not generate media or charge an account.

Reference-image selection now uses a compatible gpt-image-1 model and reaches the attached-reference state, but its image task did not reach Completed within 101 seconds; backend task/provider execution evidence is required before the image fixtures can be accepted.
The shared Playwright cache is locked and checked by android:doctor, but the repository does not yet contain a pinned Playwright package or OAuth/WebView/download-page browser suite.
The backend candidate is source-tested only and has not been deployed.
